name: TVI
verdict: Owned by Grupo Media Capital, SGPS, S.A., listed on Euronext Lisbon; its large shareholders are private Portuguese investment vehicles and individuals, largest Pluris Investments (37.11%), the vehicle of chairman Mário Ferreira. Nothing found.
note: Portuguese free-to-air TV channel of the Media Capital group. Upper-chest sponsor at Moreirense in 2026-27. Prisa (Spain) controlled Media Capital until November 2020; the group has no state in its chain (its own shareholder disclosure, 15 Sep 2025).
